name: RB-A3: list counts agree with dashboard (and Home tile)
description: Same-token snapshot: list rows vs /api/v1/rentals/vendor/dashboard stats. Dashboard upcoming/completed are period-scoped (scheduled_start in period). Home Upcoming Booking tile reads the same dashboard.upcoming value (RB-L14). A period-filtered list count that disagrees with dashboard is a data bug. /stats returning empty is recorded; UI LazyColumn undercount stays a separate watch vs RB-L14.
